statement.name: Zero-v Cantor composition cancellation and quintic factorization
statement.source: Scalar d^2*(a*b)=(d*a)*(d*b) and x*(x-1)*(x+1)*(x^2+1)=x^5-x, combined with an independent variable t. Does not prove gcd selection, all64 reductions, group structure, subgroup counts or Picard identification.

independence: Producer-issued on one host with unchanged repository checker. Only scalar cancellation/factorization identities are sampled. Actual F3 gcd, all-pair reduction, group and subgroup statements require the cited Lean proofs; geometric Picard identification remains separate. No signed or independent-host standing.
